summary_en: FY3/30 targets: ROE 9%+, ROIC 9%+, sustained capital cost outperformance. New 4-year plan (FY3/27–FY3/30): consolidated sales ¥220bn, EBITDA ¥23bn. SR function established; investor engagement expanded via individual investor forums, sustainability disclosures, English-language reporting.
title_en: Response to Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief:
Mitsui DM Sugar filed an update on capital-cost-conscious management on 16 June 2026. The disclosure reports a fresh assessment of capital efficiency performance and prospective targets.

Current performance (FY3/26): ROE stood at 3.5%, below the prior mid-term plan target of 7%+, though the 5-year average ROE of 5.6% falls within the company's assumed equity cost of capital range (4.3%–5.9%). ROIC for FY3/26 reached 7.3%, exceeding the WACC estimate of 3.7%–4.5%, but the 5-year average ROIC of 3.9% trails WACC. Price-to-book ratio remains depressed at 0.94×, reflecting both capital-efficiency headroom and investor underappreciation of growth-strategy credibility.

Prospective targets (FY3/30): A new 4-year mid-term plan (FY3/27–FY3/30) targets consolidated sales of ¥220bn, EBITDA of ¥23bn, ROE of 9%+, and ROIC of 9%+, aiming for consistent outperformance of capital costs. Key initiatives include business-portfolio management (leveraging division-level ROIC to embed balance-sheet and cash-flow discipline), enhanced investor engagement (new Stakeholder Relations function under CFO authority, individual investor forums, expanded English-language and sustainability reporting), and board-level oversight of capital allocation rationale.
